issues: Use smooth volume transitions (`setTargetAtTime` or `linearRampToValueAtTime`) in `setMuted`, `setMusicVolume`, and `setSfxVolume` instead of instantaneous `setValueAtTime` to prevent audible clicks/pops when controls are toggled during playback.
Reset `nextBeatTime` to `now + 0.1` inside `_startAmbientMusic` if `nextBeatTime < now` to prevent a massive burst of scheduled notes after tab switching or audio context suspension.
Cache and reuse the white noise buffer in `_synthChop` and `_startNatureNoise` instead of reallocating and filling buffers via `Math.random()` on every trigger.
Add a `destroy()` / cleanup method to clear `musicTimer` interval and stop `natureSource` to avoid background leaks when re-instantiating Audio.
